_about: Synthetic players for FETCH! playtests (6 Oct 2026). Numbers drive the persona bots in the playtest lab; the text drives the persona reviews. reads: none = cannot read the hints or cards; short = reads hints of up to 4 words, skips longer ones and the story cards; all = reads everything. reaction_ms: delay before an intended press. timing_sd_ms: spread of when a press lands around the right moment. hold_error: chance a press needs a held A but gets a tap (or the other way round). discovery_s: mean seconds of trying buttons before finding a mechanic nobody told them about. patience: failed tries at the same spot before they quit (kids, Anna) or ask for help. explore: chance to go for an optional bone route or a gold bone. rush: skips optional things and hates waiting.

personas.name: Elsa
personas.bio: Plays on the family RG35XX after watching her dad. Cannot read the hints yet. Loves dogs, barks along with Pepper, presses Y just for fun. Gets upset when Pepper gets hurt. Plays 10 minutes.

personas.name: Liam
personas.bio: Reads short words, skips long sentences and story cards. Collector: wants every bone. Tries every button. Proud when he beats a hard bit.

personas.name: Maja
personas.bio: Confident, has played Mario on a Switch. Wants a challenge and secrets, gets bored in empty stretches, says 'too easy' a lot. Likes the story.

personas.name: Anna
personas.bio: Rarely plays games. Plays a level with her daughter, hands the console back when stuck. Wants it calm, kind and clear; dislikes timers and getting hurt.

personas.name: Johan
personas.bio: Grew up on Super Mario World. Plays first to see if it suits his kids, then helps them through hard parts. Cares that it is fair, readable and age-appropriate.

personas.name: Mikael
personas.bio: Speedrunner with an RG35XX. Ignores text, mashes through cards. Wants tight controls, momentum and skips; hates forced waits (boat, tram, magpie).

personas.name: Sara
personas.bio: Completionist. Checks every corner for bones and secrets, wants 100% and a reason to replay. Notices when optional routes are not rewarded.

personas.name: Tomas
personas.bio: Plays his RG35XX in bed, nostalgic for 16-bit platformers. Judges game feel, sound, readability on a 3.5 inch screen and whether it feels authentically 90s.
